gen-gf-underdog-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Underdog draws every curve like bent wire, with a horseshoe-wide c and no swelling anywhere. Sawarabi Gothic follows in a sans with open jaws on its rounded strokes, quiet enough to let the heading talk.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-shanti: Shanti reads modern and businesslike, its e opening generously at the entry. Underdog sits over that plain sans like glass tubing, hollow and uniform, giving the page one loud voice and one steady one.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-shippori-antique:
Underdog's horseshoe c gives it away at once.

Shippori Antique answers beneath it with a single-weight skeleton and bowls tipped open like a ladle, so the plain sans lets the display lettering keep its swagger.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Underdog is built for commanding display lines, every curve held to one weight with a horseshoe c. Shippori Antique B1 does the quieter job, letting daylight into each curve with the steady line of a stencil brush.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-sn-pro:
Loud, wiry, and unshaded up top.

SN Pro takes over below with open apertures across the whole alphabet, so a long passage in this sans-serif keeps moving without any brush-like pressure swelling to slow the eye.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-snippet: Bent-wire lettering meets a crescent-wrench c, and both fonts share that wiry, wide-open look across every word. Approachable and consistent.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-sour-gummy: Expressive is the mood Underdog sets, its horseshoe c and unshaded curves running steady from word to word. Shrink it down, though, and Sour Gummy's wide gaps are what keep a plain sans crisp.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-source-sans-3: Underdog outlines its letters like steel cable, with no thick-thin shift and a horseshoe-wide c. Loud display work is its job; Source Sans 3 handles text, with an a whose lower bowl breathes.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-special-gothic: Underdog builds its letters from rods rather than carved blades, with a horseshoe c that commands attention. And Special Gothic, rounded and inviting, gives the sans below a friendlier tone that keeps the page approachable.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-spinnaker:
Pen-line precision, like a technical drawing, defines Underdog.

Spinnaker keeps its apertures connected to the space outside, so a long passage in this sans moves along easily and feels modern, even beneath such a forceful heading.
